title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 16, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.7 (Peaked October 17, 2026 at 00:48 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C6.0 (Peaked October 16, 2026 at 19:14 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 460 km/s (Elevated)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 4

Small solar spark! 💥

Today’s solar images show two visible active regions and a prominent elongated coronal-hole structure, while the outer corona appears streamer-dominated.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
